definitions.gloss: person who gets lonely easily; someone who doesn't like being alone
definitions.explanation: a person who frequently feels lonely and seeks company or attention from others

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}だ。
examples.english: He is someone who gets lonely easily.

examples.japanese: {寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I get lonely easily, so I don't like being alone.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{留守番|るすばん}→留守番：15546_rusuban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: Our dog gets lonely easily and doesn't do well when left alone.

notes:
FORMS:
- ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧ (lonely) + ⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ (to show signs of) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (person who tends to be)

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Also written as {淋|さび}し⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧.

PERSONALITY SUFFIX -{屋|や}:
This suffix creates personality types:
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shy person)
- {怖|こわ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (scaredy-cat)
- ⟦{頑張|がんば}り→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (hard worker)

USAGE:
Can also be used affectionately for pets that dislike being alone.
